title: Turkey-Brokered FGS-Opposition Talks Resume in Mogadishu; Puntland and Jubaland Boycott
detail: Turkey's MIT intelligence service facilitated two days of direct talks in Mogadishu between the Federal Government of Somalia and the opposition Somali Future Council, after months of behind-the-scenes coordination. The core dispute remained the March 2026 constitutional amendments that critics say extend President Mohamud's term by a year and push elections to 2027. Puntland and Jubaland boycotted the talks, rejecting Turkey as a neutral mediator and citing the use of Turkish-supplied weapons in internal Somali confrontations; Turkey maintains a large military base in Somalia and had deployed F-16s there in 2026 for counter-Al-Shabaab operations.

media.caption: Al-Monitor (Jul 2026): Turkey brokers intra-Somalia talks as federal rifts test Ankara's influence
